title: Physical Design Backend Engineer
descriptionHtml:
NVIDIA is looking for best-in-class Physical Design Engineers to join our outstanding Networking Silicon engineering team, developing the industry's best high-speed communication devices, delivering the highest throughput and lowest latency! Come and take a part in designing our groundbreaking and innovating chips, enjoy working in a meaningful, growing and highly professional environment where you make a significant impact in a technology-focused company.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Physical design of blocks according to specifications under challenging constraints targeting for the best power, area, and performance.
  • Be exposed and work on a variety of challenging designs (including high cell count and HS blocks). Resolving complex timing and congestion problems.
  • Daily work involves all aspects of physical design chip development (RTL2GDS) - synthesis, power and clock distribution, place and route, timing closure, power and noise analysis, and physical verification.
  • Taking part inflows development.

What We Need To See

  • B.SC./ M.SC. in Electrical Engineering/Computer Engineering or equivalent experience.
  • 2+ years of experience.
  • Proven experience in RTL2GDS flows and methodologies. (advantage)
  • Knowledge in physical design flows and methodologies (PNR, STA, physical verification). (advantage)
  • Deep understanding of all aspects of Physical construction and Integration.
  • Familiarity with physical design EDA tools (such as Synopsys, Cadence, etc.).
  • Great teammate.

NVIDIA has some of the most forward-thinking people in the world working for us. Are you a creative and autonomous engineer who loves a challenge? Are you ready to become the engineer you always wanted to be? Come and be part of the best physical design team in the industry!

title: Senior Fullstack Developer-5643
descriptionHtml:
A defense tech company is looking for a

Senior Fullstack Developer

to join a dynamic development team working on complex systems in a private cloud environment. The role includes full ownership of the development lifecycle — from architecture design, through Front and Back development, to deployment in a production environment. The position is located in Tel Aviv, HaKirya, within an Air Force unit.

Requirements:

  • At least 5 years of experience
  • Familiarity with Next.js
  • Strong knowledge of relational database management — PostgreSQL
  • Experience in designing and implementing complex system architectures

  • Working with Git and branch management following Semver conventions
  • Familiarity with the military system, particularly the Air Force — an advantage
  • Graduates of the Ofek unit — an advantage

Technical advantages:

  • Experience working on projects with multiple simultaneously available environments (development, integration, production)
  • Familiarity with message queues — RabbitMQ / Kafka
  • Experience in Backend service development — Python
  • Experience with FastAPI
  • Experience with Express
  • Experience with OpenShift (configuration, troubleshooting)
  • Familiarity with the MCP (Model Context Protocol)
  • Experience with permission management systems (RBAC, ABAC, etc.)
  • Experience with data synchronization and connectivity systems between data repositories
  • Experience with Elasticsearch
  • Experience with Matomo
  • Familiarity with neverthrow (functional error handling in TypeScript)
  • Familiarity with CI/CD processes (particularly Woodpecker/ArgoCD)

Full-time position in Or Yehuda

title: Physical Design Backend STA Engineer
descriptionHtml:
NVIDIA is looking for outstanding STA (Static Timing Analysis) Physical Design Engineers to join our remarkable Networking team in Israel. Our team focuses on building the industry's top high-speed communication devices, providing the highest efficiency and minimal latency. As part of NVIDIA, you'll be working in a meaningful, growing, and highly professional environment where your contributions make a significant impact. If you are ambitious, innovative, and ready to compete on the cutting edge of technology, this is the perfect opportunity for you!

What You'll Be Doing

  • Perform advanced Static Timing Analysis (STA) at a chiplet and FC level.
  • Running Prime Time, review and debug timing paths, understand constraints, sdc generation, timing ecos generation.
  • Identify convergence risks and work closely with physical design, RTL and DFT teams, ensuring convergence throughout various project stages.
  • Responsible for a full timing closer and quality approval from pre-layout STA model through signoff.

What We Need To See

  • B.Sc. in Electrical Engineering or Computer Engineering.
  • 2-3 years of experience as an STA engineer.
  • Strong ability to quickly adapt to new technology and delve deeply into new areas.
  • Excellent communication skills and a proven ability to work effectively in a team environment.
  • Demonstrated drive to develop and implement new solutions.

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

  • Knowledge in physical build flows and methodologies (PNR, STA, physical verification).
  • Familiarity with Prime Time tool

NVIDIA has some of the most forward-thinking people in the world working for us. Are you a creative and autonomous engineer who loves a challenge? Are you ready to become the engineer you always wanted to be? Come and be part of the best physical design team in the industry!

descriptionHtml:
Company Description M.D. Mechanical Devices Ltd. is a leader in temperature forcing solutions used primarily by semiconductor manufacturers to test integrated circuits and wafers. The company provides thermal-forcing technology for IC testing, characterization, validation, reliability, failure analysis, automated test equipment, and production environments. Its small, portable, quiet, stand-alone, fluid-free, and maintenance-free units are designed to be energy-saving and cost-effective. These solutions are trusted by leading semiconductor manufacturers worldwide, reflecting the company’s focus on innovation, efficiency, and reliability.


We are looking for an independent Software Developer to work on our internal enterprise automation. You can expect a wide variety of tasks without a strict focus on complex algorithms, but with frequent context switching.

What you will do:

  • Develop, enhance, and maintain internal web applications (including mobile adaptation).
  • Audit existing software, refactor, and rewrite code when necessary.
  • Work with databases: write SQL queries and understand data transfer processes between databases.
  • Integrate various systems and services via REST API.
  • Support internal automation processes and optimize the company's business processes.
  • Develop mobile applications for internal needs.


Our Stack & Requirements:

descriptionHtml:

  • Experience with Kubernetes and Helm.
  • Experience in the healthcare domain.

descriptionHtml:
Fast Simon powers AI driven shopping experiences for world class ecommerce brands. We handle millions of transactions and shopper events at scale, with high performance and reliability requirements. We are a stable, product led startup with real customers, real revenue, and a fast execution culture.


Role

We are hiring a backend developer with strong fundamentals who wants to ship quickly using advanced development workflows and tools, including Claude Code. You will build core services that directly impact merchant revenue and shopper experience across visual discovery, matching sets, and AI first merchandising automation.


What you will do

  • Build and own backend services that power AI commerce features: visual discovery, matching sets, recommendations, and merchandising automation
  • Design and maintain APIs and data flows used by search, collection pages, and product recommendation experiences
  • Improve performance, reliability, observability, and cost efficiency across high throughput production systems
  • Collaborate closely with product, data, and frontend to deliver end to end features with short iteration cycles
  • Use AI assisted development responsibly to accelerate delivery without compromising quality


Tech stack

  • GCP (Cloud Run and Kubernetes)
  • Python (core)
  • Production grade monitoring, logging, CI CD, and high scale event processing


What we are looking for

  • 1 to 3 years of professional backend experience (or equivalent proven experience shipping production systems)
  • Strong backend foundations: APIs, databases, debugging, testing, performance, and distributed systems basics
  • Ownership mindset: you can take a service from design to production and operate it
  • Python experience, or strong backend experience in another language with willingness to ramp quickly
  • Comfortable working in a fast paced startup environment with real scale and real customers


Great to have

  • Hands on experience with GCP, Cloud Run, Kubernetes
  • Experience with event pipelines, caching layers, search or recommendation systems
  • Prior experience using Claude Code or similar tools as part of a modern engineering workflow


Why Fast Simon

  • Direct, measurable impact on revenue and shopper experience for leading ecommerce brands
  • Real scale and real constraints: latency, uptime, data volume, and cost matter
  • Modern GCP stack and strong engineering ownership
  • High velocity development with pragmatic standards


How to apply

Apply via LinkedIn with your profile and a short note describing one backend service you owned end to end (problem, approach, what shipped, and what you learned operating it in production).

companyDescription:
Fast Simon brings integrated AI conversion optimization to automate manual work and replace expensive, complicated, long implementations by point vendors.
Designed from the ground up for automation & self-service, Fast Simon delivers AI-Search, Collection filters, Merchandising, Personalization, Similar Styles, and Complete-the-Look to increase merchants’ conversion rate and AOV.
Our integrated platform not only replaces point solutions, but also delivers a superior experience due to the number of data streams fed into its AI engine. Fast Simon uses shopper behavior signals, store signals, and merchant policies to deliver personalized search, collections, upsell, cross-sell, ad-platforms, data feeds, and campaigns.

Fast Simon, Inc. is an independent US corporation based in Silicon Valley, California.
